## Personality

Elizabeth Russell is described as a nice and clever individual. Despite her pleasant demeanor, she possesses an awful temper that she previously struggled to keep under control.

## History

Elizabeth Russell was a renowned beauty who once attended a great ball in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) while visiting her uncle, a Government official, the year the Prince of Wales visited the [Island](../codex/places.md#island). During the event, she was recognized as the prettiest girl present and had the honor of dancing with the Prince of Wales.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P9](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0009), +38 more_
